description: This file defines the ProductDetailActivity class, an Android activity that displays details of a product, allowing users to view information and add the product to their cart or navigate to the cart.

classes.name: ProductDetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that shows product details and provides options to add the product to the cart or view the cart.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the UI, retrieves product information from intent extras, and sets up button click handlers.
